lines.text: Aries, the chase was the part you loved, not the person.
lines.caption: you knew this already

lines.text: Aries, if you have to win the argument, you lose the evening.
lines.caption: let it go

lines.text: Aries, someone who makes you wait is not a challenge. They are an answer.
lines.caption: not a game

lines.text: Aries, slow is not the same as boring. Let someone take their time with you.
lines.caption: slow down

lines.text: Aries, you text first, then wonder why you always text first.
lines.caption: check the thread

lines.text: Aries, a fight at midnight is never about the dishes.
lines.caption: it was never the dishes

lines.text: Aries, wanting them most when they pull away is a reflex, not a feeling.
lines.caption: reflex not romance

lines.text: Aries, love is not a race and nobody is keeping score but you.
lines.caption: nobody is counting

lines.text: Aries, the spark fades. What stays after it is the real test.
lines.caption: after the spark

lines.text: Aries, say sorry before you say you were right.
lines.caption: sorry comes first

lines.text: Aries, falling fast feels brave. Staying is the brave part.
lines.caption: stay this time

lines.text: Aries, the person who stays calm in your storm is rare. Notice them.
lines.caption: notice the calm one

lines.text: Aries, you get jealous fast and calm down fast. Wait for the second part.
lines.caption: wait for the second part

lines.text: Aries, they are not your rival. Stop trying to beat them.
lines.caption: same team

lines.text: Aries, you don't need to lead every dance to enjoy the song.
lines.caption: let them lead

lines.text: Aries, the third date is where you usually leave. Try a fourth.
lines.caption: try a fourth

lines.text: Aries, a closed door is not an invitation to kick it.
lines.caption: leave the door

lines.text: Aries, saying it first is not the same as saying it well.
lines.caption: say it well

lines.text: Aries, you fell for the version of them that was hard to get.
lines.caption: hard to get

lines.text: Aries, love that needs a fight to feel alive is just a fight.
lines.caption: put the gloves down

lines.text: Aries, not every silence is a challenge you have to answer.
lines.caption: silence is fine

lines.text: Aries, stop starting things with people you already know you'll leave.
lines.caption: you know already

lines.text: Aries, they wanted to be held, not rescued.
lines.caption: no rescue needed

lines.text: Aries, cooling off is not losing. Walk away and come back kind.
lines.caption: come back kind

lines.text: Aries, you lose interest the second it gets easy. Easy was the point.
lines.caption: easy was the point

lines.text: Aries, impatience in love looks a lot like fear.
lines.caption: it looks like fear

lines.text: Aries, being first to leave does not mean you won.
lines.caption: nobody won

lines.text: Aries, let them see you soft. It costs less than you think.
lines.caption: soft looks good

lines.text: Aries, your ex was not the prize. The lesson was.
lines.caption: the lesson was

lines.text: Aries, ask how their day was, then actually wait for the answer.
lines.caption: wait for it

lines.text: Aries, the start is easy for you. The middle is where you grow.
lines.caption: the middle part

lines.text: Aries, you have ten first chapters and no endings.
lines.caption: write the ending

lines.text: Aries, finish one thing this week. Just one.
lines.caption: just one thing

lines.text: Aries, rest is not quitting. Even fire needs air.
lines.caption: fire needs air

lines.text: Aries, not everyone is racing you. Some people are just walking.
lines.caption: nobody is racing

lines.text: Aries, the anger fades in ten minutes. The words you said don't.
lines.caption: words stay

lines.text: Aries, boredom is not a sign to start over. It is a sign to keep going.
lines.caption: keep going

lines.text: Aries, losing a round is not losing. Leaving the ring is.
lines.caption: stay in the ring

lines.text: Aries, a new plan feels like progress. It usually isn't.
lines.caption: not another plan

lines.text: Aries, the person you keep competing with doesn't know the game exists.
lines.caption: they aren't playing

lines.text: Aries, impatience is just a plan to skip the part that teaches you.
lines.caption: that part teaches

lines.text: Aries, speed is not direction. Check where you are running.
lines.caption: which way though

lines.text: Aries, the restart button is not a strategy.
lines.caption: stop pressing restart

lines.text: Aries, nothing changes until the boring part becomes a habit.
lines.caption: the boring part

lines.text: Aries, hold the first reaction for three breaths before you act.
lines.caption: three breaths

lines.text: Aries, you are allowed to lose and still be the main character.
lines.caption: still the main character

lines.text: Aries, discipline is just passion that shows up on a Tuesday.
lines.caption: show up tuesday

lines.text: Aries, the urge to quit always arrives right before it gets good.
lines.caption: right before it gets good

lines.text: Aries, stop comparing your day three to someone's year ten.
lines.caption: day three energy

lines.text: Aries, being first matters less than still being there at the end.
lines.caption: be there at the end

lines.text: Aries, you burn bright. Learn to burn long.
lines.caption: burn long

lines.text: Aries, the thing you quit at week three is still waiting at week three.
lines.caption: week three again

lines.text: Aries, not every thought deserves to become a plan by tonight.
lines.caption: sleep on it

lines.text: Aries, sitting still is not wasting time. It is how you hear yourself.
lines.caption: sit still

lines.text: Aries, a half-built life is still worth finishing.
lines.caption: keep building

lines.text: Aries, the fight you picked today was with yourself.
lines.caption: you vs you

lines.text: Aries, your speed impresses people. Your follow-through earns their trust.
lines.caption: follow through

lines.text: Aries, the loudest person in the room is rarely the one in charge.
lines.caption: lead quieter

lines.text: Aries, what if the thing you keep starting over is fine the way it is?
lines.caption: maybe it's fine

lines.text: Aries, wanting it now is how you keep getting it never.
lines.caption: now or never

lines.text: Aries, you fall for a face in a second. Give their sky a minute first.
lines.caption: a minute first

lines.text: Aries, if you're the only one chasing, it isn't a match. It's a sprint.
lines.caption: a sprint for one

lines.text: Aries, you leave fast. Release them with a sentence, not a silence.
lines.caption: a sentence not silence

lines.text: Aries, say your dealbreakers on the first date. You'd say them by the third anyway.
lines.caption: say it on date one

lines.text: Aries, your Sun charges in. Your Venus might want to be courted slowly.
lines.caption: courted slowly

lines.text: Aries, you lost one round. At 11:11 the whole game resets.
lines.caption: the game resets

lines.text: Aries, the first thing out of your mouth is fast. Make it true, too.
lines.caption: fast and true

lines.text: Aries, going first doesn't mean going alone. Someone is already on their way.
lines.caption: someone is on the way

lines.text: Aries, last week's grudge is slowing you down. Release it and run.
lines.caption: drop it and run

lines.text: Aries, a bad hand is not a reason to quit the game. There is always another deck.
lines.caption: another round
